## Research interests

Computational methods for spatial transcriptomics, cell-cell communication, and subcellular gene expression.

## Current project

::: {.research-panel}
[In progress]{.panel-label}

### Subcellular context in cell-cell communication

Cells produce many of the signals they send to each other within specialized compartments, such as the endoplasmic reticulum (ER). My current work explores how this subcellular context can inform predictions of cell-cell communication from spatial transcriptomics data.

**Keywords:** spatial transcriptomics · subcellular organization · cell-cell communication
:::
